description: Update an existing Alert in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_alert afterwards to see the updated record.

cephClusters.description: List of Ceph clusters affected by this alert.

cloudResources.description: List of cloud resources affected by this alert.

databaseServers.description: List of databases affected by this alert.

description.description: Short description of this alert. This will be visible on the status page. This is in markdown.

dockerHosts.description: List of Docker hosts affected by this alert.

dockerResources.description: List of Docker resources (containers, images, networks, volumes) affected by this alert.

dockerSwarmClusters.description: List of Docker Swarm clusters affected by this alert.

iotFleets.description: List of IoT fleets affected by this alert.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

monitorStatusWhenThisAlertWasCreatedId.description: Monitor Status ID when this alert was created.

networkDevices.description: List of network devices affected by this alert.

onCallDutyPolicies.description: List of on-call duty policies affected by this alert.

podmanHosts.description: List of Podman hosts affected by this alert.

podmanResources.description: List of Podman resources (containers, images, networks, volumes) affected by this alert.

proxmoxClusters.description: List of Proxmox clusters affected by this alert.

remediationNotes.description: Notes on how to remediate this alert. This is in markdown.

rootCause.description: What is the root cause of this alert?

serviceLevelObjectives.description: List of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) affected by this alert.

services.description: List of services affected by this alert.

storageArrays.description: List of storage arrays affected by this alert.
